Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute pain and swelling of the right knee.
Mechanism of injury and force of impact are consistent with the reported knee complaints. Imaging and physical
examination findings clearly confirm the injury, and no prior ijnury to the same body area is known from the patient
history. Conservative management was provided over approximately 30 visits, including physical therapy,
range-of-motion and strengthening exercises, and activity modification. Treatment duration was somewhat longer
than typical for this type of injury, reflecting a gradual but steady response to care. Patient has shown functional
improvement with ongoing rseidual stiffness on prolonged standing. Billing records reflect single entries for each
service with no repeated charges. Continued home exercise program and follow-up as needed are recommended.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
